LanguageData.DreamsOutposts_AmmunitionDump.label: 弹药库
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts_AmmunitionDump.descriptio: 受保护的炮弹储存设施，使此据点每次炮击额外发射三枚炮弹。\n\n(DR) Dream's Outposts Expanded
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts_Fortifications.label: 防御工事
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts_Fortifications.descriptio: 加固的射击阵地与预筑的据点，为抵御攻击提供可靠防护。\n\n(DR) Dream's Outposts Expanded
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts_MortarEmplacement.label: 迫击炮阵地
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts_MortarEmplacement.descrip: 构筑在据点外围的常设迫击炮阵地。凭借射表、预置弹药与加固射击位，熟练的驻员可对附近目标实施高爆火力打击。\n\n(DR) Dream's Outposts Expanded
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts_TemporaryDefenses.label: 临时防御工事
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts_TemporaryDefenses.descrip: 以土垒、射击踏台与临时路障构成的一道简易防线。\n\n(DR) Dream's Outposts Expanded
